what_it_is: Proportion of SkillsFuture Credits Courses Taken with Direct Relevance to Individuals' Ongoing or Future Employment

sections.label: SkillsFuture Credit course conditions
sections.summary: Conditions apply to courses usable with SkillsFuture Credit, with the $4,000 mid-career top-up for curated courses and the $500 opening credit for lifelong learning.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: But I will provide some further details, specific to the question that Mr Shawn Loh has also filed for today.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: There are conditions imposed on the types of courses that the SkillsFuture Credit can be used for, to ensure that the courses taken meet our policy intent.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For example, the $4,000 SkillsFuture Credit (Mid-Career) top-up targets mid-careerists aged 40 and above, and can only be used for curated courses with stronger employment objectives.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: On the other hand, immediate relevance to employment is not the objective of the opening SkillsFuture Credit of $500, which is intended to encourage lifelong learning and skills development across different life stages.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Overall, across SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG)-supported training, eight in 10 learners find the course content relevant to their work.

sections.label: Funding for culture and employment
sections.summary: Funding is split between developing culture and employment opportunities, with sector agencies and industry partners mapping manpower needs to curate training programmes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The short answer to all of his questions is yes and we will continue to try to do better and develop more data on these issues.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Indeed, we have part of the funding focused on developing the culture, and then part of the funding focused on employment opportunity development; in other words, in mid-career to create the opportunity for someone to transition into another career and have fulfilling employment as a result.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We work with the sector agencies and with industry partners.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We map out manpower needs to identify jobs and skills gaps.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: And we do want to then curate the training programmes with the training providers to close those gaps.
